reasoning: 1. TARGET ENGAGEMENT: No biomarker or PD data available to assess whether bemcentinib engaged AXL or pembrolizumab engaged PD-1. Cannot determine if targets were hit. 2. PATHWAY MODULATION: No pathway biomarkers reported to assess whether AXL inhibition modulated immune microenvironment or checkpoint blockade activated T-cell immunity. 3. CLINICAL TRANSLATION: Primary endpoint (ORR) completely failed with 0% response rate. PFS also failed. No clinical benefit observed. 4. POPULATION EFFECTS: No subgroup analyses reported. 5. CONFOUNDERS: Single-arm trial with small sample size (N=29) terminated for futility. No control arm for comparison. Safety profile shows multiple SAEs including transaminase elevations, but these don't appear to have prevented adequate dosing over 52 weeks.

failure_modes.evidence: No biomarker data, no target engagement evidence, single-arm design with no historical benchmark for comparison, terminated for futility
